slug: 2025-06-05 São Tomé and Principe pilots MOSIP-based national digital ID system

systems.owner: Justice Ministry (its systems analyst spoke for the delegation at ID4Africa 2025)
systems.tiers: Pilot phase, begun in 2024; no fixed timeline for nationwide rollout at June 2025

note: A Justice Ministry analyst says the digital ID work started with civil registration and that a good system capturing all citizens' data exists, and the article credits digitisation for 98 per cent birth-certificate coverage in 2023; none of it says how or where a birth or death is registered, and no civil registration system is named.
